name: itquest
description: A browser-based simulation of an enterprise IT department: a nested desktop OS, a live infrastructure model, and procedurally generated support tickets graded from real system state.
author: Otari Kharebashvili

scripts.//build:check: A production build that does NOT touch .next, so it can run while `npm run dev` is up. `next build` and `next dev` share .next and clobber each other — a build mid-session leaves the running dev server throwing `Cannot find module './NNN.js'` until it is restarted.
scripts.test:physics: rm -rf .test-build tsconfig.test.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node tests/prepare.mjs && node tests/rack-physics.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:physics
